open_issues.text: findings F1, F2 of review round 1 were corrected after the last review round the limit allows; the correction was not reviewed again

summary: F1: the schema-compat step now captures the compat tool's stderr and reports `skip` (with the reason) when the tool exits non-zero with SCHEMA_COMPAT_BASE_INVALID, so base-loader failures no longer turn CI red. Any other compat failure, such as a breaking change, still fails. F2: contracts() no longer accepts a bare $id check. load_contract is followed by an explicit resolve of every $ref. If both loaders fail, the set is retried with only the open `<prefix>extension:` slots stubbed (plan/v1 -> orchestration.options, supplied by the planner-orch bridge). Any other profile or reference error fails. Non-v<N> declared folders (skiller `schema/`, draft-07) now get an explicit check: JSON object, `$schema` present, local $refs resolve. The old document_problems fallback is removed. scripts/test-ci-matrix.py gained a StepTests class with 6 tests: clean schema passes; an unresolved $ref that keeps $id fails; a profile violation that keeps $id fails; a broken legacy folder fails and a fixed one passes; BASE_INVALID is a reported skip; a real compat error still fails. Tests run: test-ci-matrix.py (23 OK), `run --unit planner/skiller/planner-orch --step contracts` (ok), `run --unit brain` (ok, lint skipped: ruff and pipx are absent), `--check` (exit 0), `public-hygiene.py` (0 violations), `run --step schema-compat --base-ref HEAD` for planner, harness and skiller (skip) and aicore (ok), and test-docs-impact.py (output looked fine, exit code not captured).
